messages.text: I can’t refund the cookware set through this process because the order hasn’t been delivered yet, and refunds are only available for delivered orders. The shop also needs to have received the item back before refunding it. (refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders) (refund-policy/v1/return)
What can I do to return it and get a refund once it’s delivered?

messages.text: Once the order is marked delivered, return the cookware set and wait until the shop’s records show it has been received back. Then request a refund within 30 days of the delivery time recorded on your order. (refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders) (refund-policy/v1/return) (refund-policy/v1/window)
